title: Honua competitor evidence record set (v1)
description: Structured, immutable-per-observation evidence backing every external claim projected into docs/comparison.md (honua-io/honua-sdk-js#499, REQ-005/REQ-006, NFR-002). Refreshing a claim adds a new observation; it never rewrites an existing record's provenance.

categories.description: Category boundaries. A comparison may only place products in the same table when they share a category, or when the rendered page names the boundary explicitly (REQ-002).

unit.description: The metric unit. Two metrics may only be combined or ranked against each other when unit AND compression match (NFR-002).

package.description: The exact package the record represents. A comparison must never substitute a narrower proxy package for one competitor only (REQ-002).

versionLine.description: The product version or release line the observation applies to. Required: an undated, unversioned external claim is not admissible evidence (REQ-005).

sourceType.description: Only 'primary' is admissible for projection. 'secondary' records are retained for provenance but may not be rendered.

primarySourcePrefixes.description: Official origin+path prefixes for this product. sourceUrl must start with one of them, so a third-party blog restating a vendor number can never pass as primary evidence.

historical.description: True when the observation describes a release line that is no longer current. A historical record may never support a current headline, ratio, or superiority claim (REQ-006).

supersededBy.description: Record id carrying the current release line, when this record is historical.

comparability.description: What this record may and may not be compared against, in plain language.
